title: Wardrobe and Weather
author: Freya Vasquez
blurb: Petra Thornbury, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the demolition date arrives.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
